title: KARTI THI FUGHAAN FATIMA ZEHRA MEREBABA
body:
Karti thi Fughaan Fatima Zehra MereBaba
Beti Huwi Ab Aapki Tanha MereBaba
Bechain bahot apke hain dono Nawase
Ajaaiye ghar hogaya suna MereBaba
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe pa Muhammad ke yahi kahti thi Zahra
Yu mujhse khafa hoke na jana MereBaba
Hay Teri Shahadat se har ek simt udasi
Ab hogaya sunsaan Madina MereBaba
<<DIVIDER>>
Rone bhi nahi'n deta Mujhe Tum pa zamana
Ghut ghut ke main kabtak rahu'n zinda MereBaba
Is tarah bhi Beti se khafa hota hai koi
Deti hay sada Aapki Zahra MereBaba
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain ye kehte hain nahi'n poochhta koi
Kya kahke unhe doon main dilasa MereBaba
Pas Apne bulalo to sukoon aaega Mujhko
Jab Tum na rahe ji ke karun kya MereBaba
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kahke sambhalenge Ali Binte Nabi ko
Ghash me hai magar lab pa hay Naoha MereBaba
Bas Binte Nabi ka tha Rasheed ik yahi Naoha
BabaMereBabaMereBabaMereBaba
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
